name: Hidden Menu Options
author: wolfsdk
description: Turns on menu options the retail game hides: the main menu entry to the developer menu (menu_showOptionForDevMenu), the SAS menu entry (menu_showOptionForSASMenu), the hardest difficulty without finishing the game first (menu_allowMeinLeben) and the photo mode setting (g_setting_photomode). The menu code reads all four; what photo mode does in this game is unknown. They are developer cvars the console refuses, so the loader writes them into the game's default.cfg. Not yet confirmed in game.
